verdict.rationale: Instinct's Terms document a first-party training opt-out at app.instinct.com/settings, and state that Materials added to the Vault are never used to train AI models. Together these give users direct control over training use. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that "Materials" covers chat and call conversations, detail on the default setting and how far the opt-out reaches, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the opt-out works.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models

citations.quote: If you do not want us to use your Materials to train AI models, you can opt out by visiting app.instinct.com/settings.
we will only use such Materials to provide the Services to you and will not use such Materials to train AI models.
